headers.comment: Next's build output is content-hashed, so a new build produces a new filename. Safe to cache forever.
Project screenshots are NOT content-hashed — replacing scribble.webp reuses the same URL. 7 days keeps repeat visits free without stranding viewers on a stale image for a year.
The resume is replaced periodically and is the one asset a visitor must not get stale. Revalidate every hour.
